title: Elements of Creation: the 92 naturally-occurring elements (Hydrogen to Uranium)
summary: Headed 'Genesis 1:1 – Elements of Creation – Genesis 2:3', the slide says there are 92 naturally-occurring elements on earth and lists them in order from Hydrogen (1), Helium (2), Lithium (3) to Uranium (92), adding up to 'The Heavens and the Earth'. Some elements are coloured (e.g. Gold yellow, Copper brown, Neon magenta).

text.text: There are 92 naturally-occurring elements on earth.
